limitations: The original dependency subaudit rebuilt only paper 0018. A separate completed root batch rebuilt all 18 manuscripts; its report and confirmed outcomes are linked under independent_all_papers_rebuild_test.
A new build is not a replacement for the byte-preserved historical PDFs or their original visual review. Different TeX releases or fonts may change layout.
No full TeX distribution, executables or machine-specific format caches are bundled as portable dependencies. A host TeX Live installation with the listed packages is still required.
Historical scripts and QA may retain old absolute paths as evidence; use resume.py and portable_tex.py for active portable operations.

historical_archives_runtime_resources.finding: All recovered ZIP resource inventories were empty for deps, fonts and TeX class/package/format files; the new vendor resources were therefore acquired separately and recorded.
